predictions.articleTitle: Decoupling Palmeiras vs Estudiantes L.P.: Expected Goals (xG), Midfield Absences & Final Preview
predictions.coreRecommendation: Palmeiras' 1.76 xG attacking advantage and Estudiantes' dual central midfield absences favor a Palmeiras win or draw in a controlled, low-scoring Libertadores final.
possibilityAssessment: Primary Thesis: Home Win / Draw — Palmeiras leads on continental xG and midfield talent while Draw covers neutral-venue final parity (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
Secondary Angle: Under 2.5 & BTTS No — Combined 2.24 lambda and Estudiantes' 48.8% scoring expectancy point to 1 or 2 total goals (Confidence: High, Value: Moderate)
Contingency Angle: 1:1 Draw Hedge — Estudiantes' 36.4% set-piece reliance targets Palmeiras' 33.3% continental clean-sheet rate (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
